I.effect_boundary: Scope expansion requires coordinator binding to existing owners; no self-signing, self-promotion or bypass of gates.

O: runtime owner and exact-file binding report
F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Expose one discoverable phone action through the existing governed RedDog/WRE boundary.
steps: Inspect existing RedDog work-order binding, signature verification, policy gate, runtime invocation and verified-authority queue contracts. Propose exact owning files before expanding this module scope.
Reuse canonical continuity, AgentDB breadcrumbs and skill/tool discovery; do not create another scheduler, dialer service or authorization system.
Bind principal instruction, resolved contact, message, durable request ID and journal location to the existing external-effect authority contract.
Implement the thin action adapter only after current runtime gates accept the binding; keep these planning JSON files separate from signed executable work orders.
Test missing or stale authority, replay, contact/message substitution, concurrent submission, restart and provider timeout. Register the tool only through the repository-owned host mechanism.
acceptance: Host discovers the phone tool and invokes the existing service through verified authority.
Unauthorized, stale or modified requests fail before any provider POST.
Retries and restarts retain the same durable journal and request binding.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
